sharedRootCauses.status: confirmed generic generation behavior; record-level claims unverified
sharedRootCauses.description: buildRecord sets imageMetadata.source to Wikimedia Commons / Wikipedia, license to CC-BY-SA / Public Domain, attribution to Lead photograph of {name} via Wikipedia/Wikimedia Commons, and sourceUrl to the English Wikipedia article. fetchWikiImages reads only the Wikipedia pageimages thumbnail source; it does not retrieve exact Commons file-page creator/source/license metadata. The script therefore does not establish these fields file-by-file; this does not prove every individual claim false.
sharedRootCauses.lineageLimit: Historical commit 07ea8de3 introduced this script with 23 index additions; that is evidence of a related expansion, not an execution log for every record matching the signature. Other matching records cannot be attributed to this script from values alone.
sharedRootCauses.rerun: The generator skips existing IDs; this preserves existing verified metadata on rerun but prevents it from enriching existing entries.
sharedRootCauses.safeFollowUp: For new records, do not create concrete license/creator claims from pageimages results. Resolve the exact Commons file and source metadata or leave claims unset/unverified. Keep the existing-ID preservation behavior. For any later legacy repair, require a reviewed ID allowlist plus exact expected-current-value guards, skip conflicts, and test manual metadata preservation and missing source evidence.
sharedRootCauses.confidence: high for code behavior and exact signature measurement; unknown for individual claim correctness and provenance of records not directly tied to generator execution
